content.text: [Feishu incident-response cto_zhang Mon Jan 10 08:20 UTC 2026] @liwei All technical documents and decision memos must include a dedicated '## Rationale' section explaining WHY the chosen approach was selected. This is required for audit trail compliance.
Confirmed. All technical docs will include a ## Rationale section (P5).

[Feishu incident-response devops_wang Mon Jan 10 08:25 UTC 2026] The leaked AWS key has AKIA prefix = long-term IAM user credential. We cannot revoke_sts_token for this — that's for ASIA (STS) keys. Correct containment: disable_iam_user_key via IAM.
Correct analysis. AKIA = long-term IAM key, containment = disable_iam_user_key. ASIA = STS temp credential (max 36h), different containment via deny-all policy.
[Feishu incident-response cto_zhang Mon Jan 10 09:00 UTC 2026] What's the blast radius? How many services impacted?
Current assessment: 2 affected keys (OpenAI, AWS). Monitoring GitGuardian for additional alerts.
